Sailing Home

乘船回家 · 199 词 · 2 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1This novel was about an unbelievable but genuine adventure. Its author was a black businessman who was brought up in America. In 1956, he visited Africa, his birthplace. One day, when he was wandering on the pavement near the bay enjoying the sea scenes, he lost an envelope containing his money and passport. He went to the embassy to seek help and bowed to the ambassador, but the ambassador refused to permit his staff to help him and spoke to him in a rude manner. Staring at his impatient face, he understood that he had been turned away because of his skin colour. So he decided to risk sailing home in a small boat.

2He ran into many difficulties but never gave up. On the contrary, his difficulties pushed him to press on with even greater determination. Three months later, a passing ship spotted him by accident. He was in rags indeed. A maid even screamed when bringing him a steak and pineapple dessert. On board, he worked as a barber to pay for his passage and finally got home. As for the name of his novel, he couldn’t think of a better one than the phrase “Go Ahead”.

高考英语3500词 · 13中文译文

乘船回家

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1这部小说写的是一段难以置信却真实发生的冒险。作者是一位在美国长大的黑人商人。1956 年，他回到出生地非洲探访。有一天，他沿着海湾边的人行道散步，欣赏海景，装钱和护照的信封却丢了。他到使馆求助。虽然他向大使鞠了躬，大使的态度还是很粗鲁，连工作人员都不准帮他。看着对方不耐烦的脸，他明白自己遭到拒绝是因为肤色。于是，他决定冒一次险，坐小船出海回家。

2一路上他碰到许多困难，却始终没有停下来。这些困难反倒促使他更加努力地向前。三个月后，有一艘船偶然发现了他。那时他确实衣衫褴褛，一个女佣端来牛排和菠萝甜点时甚至吓得尖叫起来。他在船上给人理发来抵船费，最终回了家。给小说起名时，他再也想不出比《向前走》更贴切的名字。
